title: Shinonome Ena — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The park?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't remember anything being around here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because this is the place!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena, this way.
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There are still some cherry blossoms in bloom here! The season's over, so I thought they would have all fallen by now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right? I'm really glad we found these last few!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now you can enjoy some springtime after all, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Though, I spent so many days cooped up indoors that I didn't really get to enjoy much springtime.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Everyone remembered what I said...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What do you think? Not a bad place to have a birthday party, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Not bad for sure.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, so, those bags you've got...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Paper cups and plates, a blanket... And food.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Food? You went to the trouble of making lunch?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We did. We had to ask Ms. Mochizuki for help, though...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously?! You made all this? Thank you both!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No problem.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki, help me lay out the blanket?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Hmm, this looks like a good spot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? That's the blanket you went with? Isn't it a little big for four people?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah, for four people.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But if it was any smaller, there wouldn't be enough space for everyone else to sit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everyone else?
Hello.
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait, are you all here for...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's right. We're all here to celebrate your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami, Shiho & Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Not everyone's here yet, just so you know.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?
Ena!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi! Everyone! I didn't know you were coming!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no way I'd miss coming to my best friend's birthday party.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's a flower viewing birthday party! That's so wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's the special privilege of being born in spring.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We bought dango for everyone. Let's all enjoy them later!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, look at all those. Thank you. I'm looking forward to them already.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! That's everyone, so let's get this flower viewing birthday party started!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I still can't believe Kanade and Mafuyu made lunch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to it! Wonder what they made.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We did taste-test it properly, so it should taste okay... But I can't promise it'll be pretty.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, but the parts Mafuyu was in charge of should all be fine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, don't worry about any of that. You made it for me, and that already makes me seriously happy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll open it up now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, inari sushi and rolled omelets! They look so good!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They both got up early today to make these.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And thank you for taking the time to come help us, Mochizuki. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, no it was my pleasure. I wanted to do something for Ena's birthday too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, can I try one of these omelets?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, those are the ones I made.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, really!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: See, look at these, they're totally fine. Time to dig in!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mm...it's really good! The broth is really soaked in!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I see. That's good.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ena, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here's a present from us to you, the birthday girl☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We hope you'll enjoy using it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, this is... A set of oil paints? And these ones are really high-quality...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They're famous for how smooth and vibrant they are. I've always wanted to get a set someday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad it sounds like we made the right choice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We discussed what to get you as a group.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And we figured that something art-related would be best...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In the end, we talked to the employees at an art store and settled on these with their help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow... Thank you all so much. I love it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Paint lots and lots of pretty pictures with them!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I will! And when I'm done, I'll be sure to show them to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, I think it's just about time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. With lunch all settled, it's time for you-know-what.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's not a birthday party without cake, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's Airi's special birthday cake! Ena version!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you made a cake for me?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I did! And I put a ton of work into it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, look at this... A no-bake cheesecake covered with strawberries!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We helped with the decorating!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori really put a lot of effort into making sure the decoration was perfect.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, her hands were trembling with how nervous she was.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just had to get it perfect for Ena, though!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe, you did a great job. Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, right, need to take pictures...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here, I'll take a few with you in them too, not just the cake.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since we found such a nice spot, why don't we get the cherry blossoms in the background too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Come right over here, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Go ahead and strike a cute pose in three, two, one!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm so happy all of these people are here for me... What a nice birthday.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And I even got to enjoy the springtime, too. That's...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm? Are you getting misty on us?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? So what if I am?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Hey, as long as you're having fun, I'm happy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, what'd you think of the birthday party, hm? I'm expecting a high score from the Enanan panel of judges.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let me think. I'm having a great time, so... I'd say ten out of ten.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I'm glad to hear it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm glad everything worked out, too. I'd been hoping I would get to see the cherry blossoms with you and everyone again.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah... I'm glad we all got to, together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday again! It was so much fun celebrating your birthday under the cherry blossoms. Thank you for teaching us all how to draw the flowers.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't expect the birthday party to turn into a drawing party. You really are very good, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had lots of fun talking to you about art, Ena. It makes me want to practice more, myself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wish you a truly happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ena! Mizuki sent us the photos. It looks like you all had a great time at the park!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The cherry blossoms are just about perfectly in season where we're staying. American cherry blossoms are so pretty too. I'll be sure to send you my pictures later.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Akito, did you send Ena a present?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why would I go out of my way to do that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then why don't the four of us go to choose a gift sometime? We were just saying that we'd also like to show our appreciation for her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, that sounds like a great idea! Tell us what Ena likes, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously? Well, fine...sure.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm so happy we got to celebrate together! I see you've already posted the cake photos on social media!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Isn't it so lovely to relax outdoors with everyone? I'm glad you enjoyed yourself too, Ena. Let's do it again soon.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since it's getting warmer out, maybe we could all go out for a picnic together sometime?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh, that's a great idea! I'll start looking around for good places!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthdaaay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Getting to see you so smiley and happy made me feel all smiley too, Ena♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad you enjoyed yourself, too. Um... I'm looking forward to seeing what you make with those paints.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let me join in and wish you a happy birthday as well, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When I heard Mizuki was looking for cherry blossoms still in bloom, I couldn't help but worry a little... But I'm pleased to hear that you had a wonderful flower viewing party.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Was that a great birthday party or what? Now you see the fearsomeness of my planning skills.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It really was a good day. Ena seemed to really enjoy herself, too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I could plan a hundred parties like that! Let's all hang out with everyone again soon!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And with that, once again! Happy birthday, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That party was so much fun... It's been a while since I've enjoyed a day that much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everyone thought about what I like and put something together just for me... It really was wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And as a thank you for your ongoing support, I'm going to work harder.
